campaign_name: Unit-of-Work v3.1 Milestone 5: Integrated Heterogeneous Physical Reconfirmation

authority_c.software_stack: Local Authority Service (Python reference & C++ ABI)

realization_witness.scope: Semantic realization witness only; not claimed as distributed quorum authority in M5

qualification_gates.name: Exact v3.1 Build Provenance
qualification_gates.criteria: Source commits, firmware binary hashes, board identities, COM ports, and compiler toolchains rigorously attested to v3.1 development baseline.

qualification_gates.name: Pairwise Deterministic Agreement
qualification_gates.criteria: S'_ESP32 = S'_Arduino = S'_Host for accepted work; Disposition_A = Disposition_B = Disposition_C = REJECT for invalid work across 24 bounded transitions.

qualification_gates.name: Live 2-of-3 Quorum Certification
qualification_gates.criteria: All valid 2-of-3 authority pairs (ESP32+Arduino, ESP32+Laptop, Arduino+Laptop) form commit quorum; singletons (|Q| < 2) strictly prevent commit.

qualification_gates.name: Partition and Fail-Closed Behavior
qualification_gates.criteria: Loss of communication != Gain of authority. If quorum survives, execution continues; if quorum lost, system fails closed with 0 unauthorized commits.

qualification_gates.name: Replay and Stale Authority Rejection
qualification_gates.criteria: Old epochs, stale generation counters, expired proposal hashes, delayed packets, and stale QCs produce zero state advancement and zero physical effect.

qualification_gates.name: Cross-Realization v3.1 Confirmation
qualification_gates.criteria: Heterogeneous physical parity confirmed: R_ESP32(W) ~ R_Arduino(W) ~ R_Host(W), with Rust M4 runtime verified as independent host realization witness.

qualification_gates.name: Recovery and Evidence Continuity
qualification_gates.criteria: Restarted authority catches up strictly from qualified ledger history: S_recovered = S_canonical and E_recovered = E_canonical; divergent logs quarantined.
